title: Al Ajal ya Imame
body:
al ajal al ajal ya imam e zamaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ya imam e zamaan kaaba e do jahan
de rahe hai sada ye zameen asmaan
hum shabihe nabi de chuke hai azaan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ali ay mohamed ay zehra ki jaan
kitne sadiyon se aankhein bichaye yahan
karbala dhoondti hai qadam ke nashan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaiye muntazir hai ye dunya o deen
poochti hai ye karbobala ki zameen
kitne sadiyon ka gham hai abhi darmiyan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hussain e zamaan ay mohamed ki jaan
dekhiye aaj bhi ya imam e zamaan
khoone mazloom se surkh hai aasman
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay azadare karbobala al ajal
ay alamdare deene khuda al ajal
ay shareek e aza e shahe do jahan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bhoole wo manzar imam e zamaan
wo zaeefi wo maqtal wo laashe jawan
kya qayamat ka tha karbala mein samaa
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi ashkon mein hai shaam e gham ka samaa
jalte qaime wo sehra wo uth'ta dhuaan
aaj bhi hai fazaon mein aah o fughan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi abbas ka waasta aaiye
shaah ki pyaas ka waasta aaiye
dekhiye tashna lab hai abhi bezuban
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr e ashoor shaam e alam ki qasam
zulm thamta nahi aaj bhi hai sitam
apne parcham ke saaye mein dije amaan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnagi dhoop sehra wo rayg e tapan
zer e khanjar wo sajda wo zehra ki jaan
thi sar e karbala maa ki aah o fughan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nigaah e karam ya imam e zaman
nasir e ibne zehra hai ye anjuman
hai areeza hamara ye ashk e rawan
al ajal al ajal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shabihe rasool e zaman al madad
al madad ibne khyber shikan al madad
hai fareed aaj sab ke ye wirde zuban
al ajal al ajal...
author: Fareed Baig
